## Ryohei Yamamoto (Kobayashi)

**Ryohei Yamamoto (Kobayashi), MD, PhD**<br>
Clinical epidemiology · Critical care · Causal inference · Medical AI

## Current position

- **2025–present** — Visiting Scientist, Laboratory for Computational Physiology, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
- **2024–present** — Assistant Professor, Center for Innovative Research for Communities and Clinical Excellence, Fukushima Medical University
- **2023–present** — Visiting Researcher, Clinical Epidemiology Group, Kyoto University Graduate School of Medicine
- **2019–present** — Part-time Physician, Department of Intensive Care Medicine, Kameda Medical Center

## Education and training

- **2019–2023** — PhD, Clinical Epidemiology, Kyoto University Graduate School of Medicine
- **2006–2012** — MD, Tokyo Medical and Dental University

## Qualifications

- Emergency Medicine Specialist, Japanese Association for Acute Medicine (2019)
- Intensive Care Specialist, Japanese Society of Intensive Care Medicine (2021)
- PhD in Medicine, Kyoto University (2023)
- Certified Expert, Society for Clinical Epidemiology (2024)

## Research interests

- Clinical epidemiology
- Critical care outcomes
- Causal inference using observational data
- Prediction model evaluation
- Bias, fairness, and transportability of medical AI

## Selected activities

- Executive Board Member, Japanese Society of Education for Physicians and Trainees in Intensive Care (JSEPTIC)
- Academic Editor, *PLOS Digital Health*
- Working-group member for the Japanese Clinical Practice Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock 2024 and the ARDS Clinical Practice Guidelines 2021/2024
- Editorial lead for the 2026 sepsis issue of *Intensivist*
